title: warm charred egyptian eggnoodles
description: A charred, shattering, lazy-sunday egyptian dish featuring egg noodles, nimono-simmer. This paleo-friendly meal is perfect for a bento-box serving.
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat the canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until charred, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
In a large saucepan, combine the chicken broth and water. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the cooked egg noodles to the saucepan and stir to combine. Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the noodles are well coated with the nimono mixture.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a large baking dish and drizzle with sesame oil. Season with salt to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the noodles are golden brown and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving in a bento box.
